mission: Luke in the Temple meditating; the new-Sith presence is sensed; 'He exists.'
why_now: Jacen's crossing has changed the Force.
opening_hook: Luke in the meditation chamber with Mara seated opposite him.
conflict: Luke's Force-perception confirming a new Sith presence vs. his inability to identify the Sith as Jacen.
turning_point: Luke says 'he exists'; Mara agrees without requiring further clarification.
closing_hook: Luke and Mara sitting together with the news settled between them.
sensory_details: Chamber's incense; low light; Mara's steady face.
emotional_trajectory: Settled perception → named confirmation → shared knowledge.

stakes.interpersonal: The Luke/Mara partnership at its most complete.
stakes.external: The series' engine — the new Sith is in the Force and the Skywalkers know it without naming him.

notes: The book's final line lands the series engine fully wound.
